Flight Software Engineer I
Pasadena, CA
Full-time
Onsite

NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) develops flight software and systems engineering for spacecraft and science instruments. The Flight Software Engineer I designs, implements, and tests embedded real-time software for science instruments and spacecraft capabilities, collaborating with instrument engineers and multidisciplinary teams.
Aerospace
Construction
National Defense
Robotics
National Security
Space Travel
Growth Opportunities
Responsibilities
Design and implement real-time flight software for science instruments
Work with Instrument engineers to generate software requirements and design of the flight software components that meet the project requirements
Design software modules that implement the functions of the flight system, hardware/software interfaces, boot process, C&DH functions such as Instrument operations, Science data Acquisition and control, Engineering and Science data handling, Fault Protection, Thermal Power Control in both nominal and off-nominal scenarios
Develop test plans, unit tests, regression test and evaluate test results. Run tests against simulators and testbeds
Identify and troubleshoot technical issues with flight software in an integrated system
Work with multi-disciplinary team and experienced flight software developers

Required
Bachelors in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or related technical discipline with a minimum of 1 year of related experience; Master's degree in similar disciplines; or PhD in similar disciplines with zero years of related experience
Strong C/C++ programming skills
Multi-threaded programming
Coursework in operating systems, computer architecture, algorithms, and data structures
Knowledge of principles, theories, concepts and hands-on programming techniques in:
Developing, modifying, debugging, releasing and maintaining real-time embedded software systems for mission-critical, aerospace applications
Developing embedded real-time application programs utilizing RTOS
Developing device driver and software/hardware interfaces for both custom and commercial hardware
Distributed computing and inter-process communication mechanisms in a space partitioned software architecture
Communication buses and protocols: Space Wire, PCI/PCIe,UART, Ethernet
Continues Integration, development flow, git flow process
Internship or experience with significant C or C++ programming
Internship or experience with embedded processors or microcontrollers programming or development process on CubeSats
Preferred
Coursework in programming languages, software engineering, computer science theory, embedded programming
Python, C++, or Java
Experience of applying artificial intelligence tools to technical projects
